questions.q: Find the gradient of the line 2x + 3y = 12.
questions.why: Rearrange to y = −(2/3)x + 4, so the gradient is −2/3.

questions.q: Which equation has a graph with asymptotes on both axes and two separate branches?
questions.why: Reciprocal graphs y = k/x never meet the x- or y-axis.
